matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Offense vs. Pass Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass offense grades in the 100th percentile against a unit that grades 71st — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about this Week 2 matchup: we're staring down a statistical mismatch that doesn't come around every Sunday, and I'm genuinely excited about it. Our pass offense is operating in the 100th percentile against a Steelers secondary languishing at 71st—that's the kind of edge you circle on the calendar. The concern, naturally, is that we're coming off a loss and need Drake Maye to demonstrate some of that rookie resilience, but if there's ever a spot to bounce back, it's against a Pittsburgh team averaging just 0.02 net EPA per play over their last three contests. The recent head-to-head record gives us reason for optimism too, though that 2025 loss still stings. This is our home opener, the Steelers have no reported injuries, and we're favored by 5.5—everything feels aligned for a statement game.
